description: This file defines the EntityIdExistsOption class, which encapsulates validation options for verifying that entity IDs exist, with configurable checks for numeric and positive values.

classes.name: EntityIdExistsOption
classes.description: A class representing options for entity ID validation, including whether the ID should be numeric and positive.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Returns whether the validation requires the ID to be numeric.

methods.name: setNumeric
methods.description: Sets whether the ID should be numeric.

methods.name: isPositive
methods.description: Returns whether the validation requires the ID to be positive.

methods.name: setPositive
methods.description: Sets whether the ID should be positive.
